steps_raw.instruction:
Workﬂow - QIIME 2 - Longitudinal Study
QIIME 2 Workﬂow
QIIME2 webpage: https://qiime2.org
# Import Ion Torrent single-end fastq sequences
# Sequences file are in the directory /quotesingle.ts1casava-18-single-end-demultiplexed/quotesingle.ts1
qiime tools import \
--type /quotesingle.ts1SampleData[SequencesWithQuality]/quotesingle.ts1\
--input-path casava-18-single-end-demultiplexed \
--source-format CasavaOneEightSingleLanePerSampleDirFmt \
--output-path demux-single-endL.qza &
# Check the quality plot
qiime demux summarize \
--i-data demux-single-endL.qza \
--o-visualization demux-single-endL.qzv &
# Denoise, dereplicate single-end sequences and remove chimeras
# Primer forward (trim-left) of 19 nucleotides
# Trunc-len value corresponds to the nucleotide truncation position and depends on the quality plot (median quality score > 30) and amplicon length of 245 for V4 region
qiime dada2 denoise-single \
--i-demultiplexed-seqs demux-single-endL.qza \
--p-trim-left 19 \
--p-trunc-len --- \
--p-n-threads 0 \
--o-representative-sequences rep-seqs-dada.qza \
--o-table table-dada.qza &
# check the previous outputs
qiime feature-table tabulate-seqs \
--i-data rep-seqs-dada.qza \
--o-visualization rep-seqs-dada.qzv &
qiime feature-table summarize \
--i-table table-dada.qza \
--m-sample-metadata-file metadata.tsv \
--o-visualization table-dada.qzv &
# Look at the minimum number of samples sequences; we will use 9500 as sequences depth.
# Greengenes 13.8 at 99% of Operational Taxonomic Units (OTUs) identity and trimmed to V4 region as reference database.
qiime feature-classifier classify-sklearn \
--i-classifier ./classifier_GG99.qza \
--i-reads rep-seqs-dada.qza \
--p-n-jobs -1 \
--o-classification taxonomy-clas-dada.qza &
# check the previous output
qiime metadata tabulate \
1

--m-input-file taxonomy-clas-dada.qza \
--o-visualization taxonomy-clas-dada.qzv &
# Remove chloroplast sequences (Possible contaminats)
qiime taxa filter-table \
--i-table table-dada.qza \
--i-taxonomy taxonomy-clas-dada.qza \
--p-exclude Chloroplast \
--o-filtered-table tableGG-noC-dada.qza &
# check the previous output
qiime feature-table summarize \
--i-table tableGG-noC-dada.qza \
--o-visualization tableGG-noC-dada.qzv &
### Taxonomy (The last taxonomy script was performed using QIIME 1.9.1)
## The same following script were used for table L5 and L6
# L2
qiime taxa collapse
--i-table tableGG-noC-dada.qza \
--i-taxonomy taxonomy-clas-dada.qza \
--p-level 2 \
--o-collapsed-table tableCOLL-L2.qza &
qiime feature-table relative-frequency
--i-table tableCOLL-L2.qza \
--o-relative-frequency-table L2_relative.qza &
qiime tools export \
L2_relative.qza \
--output-dir exported-feature-table-L2 &
biom convert -i exported-feature-table-L2/feature-table.biom -o table.from_biom_w_taxonomy-L2.txt --to-tsv --header-key taxonomy &
### core-diversity (alpha and beta diversity)
qiime alignment mafft \
--i-sequences rep-seqs-dada.qza \
--o-alignment aligned-rep-seqs.qza &
qiime alignment mask \
--i-alignment aligned-rep-seqs.qza \
--o-masked-alignment masked-aligned-rep-seqs.qza &
qiime phylogeny fasttree \
--i-alignment masked-aligned-rep-seqs.qza \
--p-n-threads -1 \
--o-tree unrooted-tree.qza &
qiime phylogeny midpoint-root \
--i-tree unrooted-tree.qza \
--o-rooted-tree rooted-tree.qza &
2

# Sampling depth corresponds to the minimum samples sequences value
qiime diversity core-metrics-phylogenetic \
--i-phylogeny rooted-tree.qza \
--i-table tableGG-noC-dada.qza \
--p-sampling-depth 9500 \
--m-metadata-file metadata.tsv \
--output-dir core-metrics &
### q2-longitudinal: a QIIME 2 plugin for longitudinal studies (https://www.biorxiv.org/content/early/2017/11/22/223974)
## /quotesingle.ts1shannon_vector.qza/quotesingle.ts1, /quotesingle.ts1observed_otus_vector.qza/quotesingle.ts1, /quotesingle.ts1unweighted_unifrac_distance_matrix.qza/quotesingle.ts1and /quotesingle.ts1weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix.qza/quotesingle.ts1are in the folder called /quotesingle.ts1core-metrics/quotesingle.ts1
## Alpha diversity: differences within groups of samples
qiime longitudinal pairwise-differences \
--m-metadata-file metadata_SM.tsv \
--m-metadata-file shannon_vector.qza \
--p-metric shannon \
--p-group-column Treatment \
--p-state-column Time \
--p-state-1 T0 \
--p-state-2 T5 \
--p-individual-id-column Animal_Pair \
--p-replicate-handling random \
--o-visualization shannon-pairwise-differences.qzv &
qiime longitudinal pairwise-differences \
--m-metadata-file metadata_SM.tsv \
--m-metadata-file observed_otus_vector.qza \
--p-metric observed_otus \
--p-group-column Treatment \
--p-state-column Time \
--p-state-1 T0 \
--p-state-2 T5 \
--p-individual-id-column Animal_Pair \
--p-replicate-handling random \
--o-visualization obs_otus-pairwise-differences.qzv &
## Beta diversity: differences between groups of samples
qiime longitudinal pairwise-distances \
--m-metadata-file metadata_SM.tsv \
--i-distance-matrix unweighted_unifrac_distance_matrix.qza \
--p-group-column Treatment \
--p-state-column Time \
--p-state-1 T0 \
--p-state-2 T5 \
--p-individual-id-column Animal_Pair \
--p-replicate-handling random \
--output-dir beta_div_distances_unwei/ &
qiime longitudinal pairwise-distances \
3

--m-metadata-file metadata_SM.tsv \
--i-distance-matrix weighted_unifrac_distance_matrix.qza \
--p-group-column Treatment \
--p-state-column Time \
--p-state-1 T0 \
--p-state-2 T5 \
--p-individual-id-column Animal_Pair \
--p-replicate-handling random \
--output-dir beta_div_distances_wei &
## Beta diversity: differences within groups of samples
qiime tools export \
./ALPHA_BETA_NONEGS/core-metrics-NONEGS-SM/unweighted_unifrac_pcoa_results.qza \
--output-dir ./ALPHA_BETA_NONEGS/core-metrics-NONEGS-SM/PCOA_unwei/ &
qiime tools export \
./ALPHA_BETA_NONEGS/core-metrics-NONEGS-SM/weighted_unifrac_pcoa_results.qza \
--output-dir ./ALPHA_BETA_NONEGS/core-metrics-NONEGS-SM/PCOA_wei/ &
# the output (inside the folder PCOA_unwei or PCOA_wei) had to be .tsv and the header /quotesingle.ts1#SampleID/quotesingle.ts1.
qiime longitudinal pairwise-differences \
--m-metadata-file metadata_SM.tsv \
--m-metadata-file PCOA_wei_pair.tsv \
--p-metric PC1 \
--p-group-column Treatment \
--p-state-column Time \
--p-state-1 T0 \
--p-state-2 T5 \
--p-individual-id-column Animal_Pair \
--p-replicate-handling random \
--o-visualization Wei-pairwise-differences-pcoa1-PAIRED.qzv &
qiime longitudinal pairwise-differences \
--m-metadata-file metadata_SM.tsv \
--m-metadata-file PCOA_wei_pair.tsv \
--p-metric PC2 \
--p-group-column Treatment \
--p-state-column Time \
--p-state-1 T0 \
--p-state-2 T5 \
--p-individual-id-column Animal_Pair \
--p-replicate-handling random \
--o-visualization Wei-pairwise-differences-pcoa2-PAIRED.qzv &
qiime longitudinal pairwise-differences \
--m-metadata-file metadata_SM.tsv \
--m-metadata-file PCOA_wei_pair.tsv \
--p-metric PC3 \
--p-group-column Treatment \
--p-state-column Time \
--p-state-1 T0 \
--p-state-2 T5 \
4

--p-individual-id-column Animal_Pair \
--p-replicate-handling random \
--o-visualization Wei-pairwise-differences-pcoa3-PAIRED.qzv &
qiime longitudinal pairwise-differences \
--m-metadata-file metadata_SM.tsv \
--m-metadata-file PCOA_unwei_pair.tsv \
--p-metric PC1 \
--p-group-column Treatment \
--p-state-column Time \
--p-state-1 T0 \
--p-state-2 T5 \
--p-individual-id-column Animal_Pair \
--p-replicate-handling random \
--o-visualization unWei-pairwise-differences-pcoa1-PAIRED.qzv &
qiime longitudinal pairwise-differences \
--m-metadata-file metadata_SM.tsv \
--m-metadata-file PCOA_unwei_pair.tsv \
--p-metric PC2 \
--p-group-column Treatment \
--p-state-column Time \
--p-state-1 T0 \
--p-state-2 T5 \
--p-individual-id-column Animal_Pair \
--p-replicate-handling random \
--o-visualization unWei-pairwise-differences-pcoa2-PAIRED.qzv &
qiime longitudinal pairwise-differences \
--m-metadata-file metadata_SM.tsv \
--m-metadata-file PCOA_unwei_pair.tsv \
--p-metric PC3 \
--p-group-column Treatment \
--p-state-column Time \
--p-state-1 T0 \
--p-state-2 T5 \
--p-individual-id-column Animal_Pair \
--p-replicate-handling random \
--o-visualization unWei-pairwise-differences-pcoa3-PAIRED.qzv &
Taxonomic analysis - R workﬂow
### For paired data
# install and load coin package
install.packages("coin")
library(coin)
# Load the taxonomy table including metadata information. Remember to divide files depending on the group in order to do the comparison between T0 and T6 (in my case) within the same group
a = L2+metadata_only_antibiotic
# Create an empty vector for p-values and the variable
outP=c()
outV=c()
5

# For all taxonomic columns (from column 6 to the end) perform the pairwise.wilcox.test depending on the variable time (column 5)
for (i in c(6:dim(a)[2])){
s=as.vector(as.matrix(a[,i]))
m=as.vector(as.matrix(a[,5]))
res=pairwise.wilcox.test(s, m, p.adj="none",exact=F, paired=T)
outP = c(outP, res$p.value)
outV = c(outV, rep(colnames(a)[i]))
}
outpvalue = data.frame(variable=outV, pvalues=outP)
View(outpvalue)
# Save the new file
write.csv2(outpvalue, /quotesingle.ts1my_output_table_L2+metadata_only_antibiotic.csv/quotesingle.ts1)
### For unpaired data we used the dunn test
# Install and load the dunn package
install.packages("dunn.test")
library(dunn.test)
The script are the same above: write /quotesingle.ts1dunn.test/quotesingle.ts1instead of pairwise.wilcox.test
